attchmntText: Univa Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Univa Foods Limited has signed agreements for two premium villa properties in Nashik and Alibaug to operate as curated holiday stays under its own brand. This expansion into the leisure hospitality segment follows an asset-light model and is subject to the execution of definitive agreements. The company plans to grow its portfolio across Maharashtra, Goa, and other destinations in a phased manner. The announcement was made on 21st November 2026 pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. A press release detailing these plans is available on the company website.

attchmntText: The Exchange has sought clarification from Univa Foods Limited for the quarter ended 30-Sep-2026 with respect to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
